tools.description: Author 1–50 tickets and up to 100 links between them in one all-or-nothing write. Each ticket carries a batch-local `ref`; links point at refs. Rejected as a whole on duplicate refs, links to refs outside the batch, self-loops, duplicate links, or a parent_of/depends_on/blocks cycle — the error lists every problem. `dry_run` validates only. Use this to lay down an epic with its children and dependency edges in one shot.

actor_id.description: Who is calling. Defaults to the server --actor. Claims are held per actor; subagents sharing one server should each pass their own.

dry_run.description: Validate and report what would happen; write nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Replay-safe key. A second call with the same key returns the first result without writing again.

ref.description: Batch-local handle other entries use to point at this ticket.

tools.description: Take a lease on one or more tickets (all-or-nothing; locked in id order so concurrent claimers cannot deadlock). Returns one claim_token per ticket — keep it, it is shown once and is required for every write. Leases are at most 600 s; refresh with sea_refresh or let them lapse. Fails with already_claimed (naming the holder and expiry) if any ticket is held by someone else. Claiming a ticket you already hold rotates its token.

lease_seconds.description: Lease length in seconds (default 300, max 600). Refresh before it lapses; expiry frees the ticket.

tools.name: sea_claim
tools.title: Claim one or more tickets

tools.description: Create one ticket (status idea, or triaged to make it dispatchable right away). Returns the ticket plus `possible_duplicates` — existing tickets with the same or a similar title; the create always goes through, you decide. Pass `claim_seconds` to claim it in the same call and get a claim_token back. `idempotency_key` makes retries safe. Kinds: feature | research | investigation | refactor | curiosity | question | other | bug | chore | incident | security | epic | spike | log | docs | decision. Priorities: urgent | high | medium | low | parked.

tools.description: With ticket_id: every chain event about that ticket (its own events and links touching it), oldest first. Without: a feed of every sea event with seq > since_seq — poll it to watch the queue. `verify` (default true) recomputes every hash on the chain and reports whether the record is intact.

tools.description: Add or remove a directed link `from <link_type> to`. Types: parent_of | relates_to | inspired_by | responds_to | conflicts_with | supersedes | blocks | depends_on | condenses_into | branches_from | references | duplicates. Fenced on the from ticket (claim_token). parent_of / depends_on / blocks are kept acyclic across all existing links; a cycle is rejected with its path. Remove tombstones the link (history keeps it). `from blocks to` and `from depends_on to` decide what sea_next may hand out: a ticket is eligible only when every predecessor is terminal.

tools.description: Filter by status (default: every non-terminal), kind, priority, assignee ("me" / "none"), tag, claim state (any / yes / no / mine), and/or full-text `query` over title and body. Paginated with an opaque cursor. `view: compact` (default) omits bodies. Ordered by priority then recency, or by relevance when querying.

tools.name: sea_list
tools.title: List and search tickets

tools.description: Dispatch: atomically pick and claim the highest-priority unclaimed triaged or in_progress ticket that is assigned to you or unassigned, is not priority parked, and whose predecessors (tickets that `blocks` it, tickets it `depends_on`) are all terminal. in_progress beats triaged at equal priority; then oldest (chain order) first. Returns ticket + claim_token, or ticket: null with reason nothing_eligible. Call it in a loop.

tools.description: Heartbeat: set the lease expiry to now + extend_by_seconds (≤ 600) if that is later than the current expiry; never shortens. Holder-only. Not recorded on the chain, so heartbeats do not flood anyone's orient delta.

extend_by_seconds.description: New expiry = now + this (max 600); never shortens an existing lease.

tools.name: sea_release
tools.title: Release a claim

tools.description: Set status. Fenced (claim_token). Legal moves: work track idea → triaged → in_progress → resolved; any active ticket may enter parked | blocked | needs_decision (resume only to idea / triaged / in_progress) or a terminal state resolved | wont_fix | duplicate | dropped | merged (no exit). to=duplicate requires duplicate_of and records a `duplicates` link. Entering a terminal state releases your claim. On rejection the error carries legal_next. Known statuses: idea | triaged | in_progress | in_design | ready | parked | blocked | needs_decision | resolved | wont_fix | duplicate | dropped | merged.

actor_id.description: Who is calling. Defaults to the server --actor. Claims are held per actor; subagents sharing one server should each pass their own.

claim_token.description: The claim token returned by sea_claim or sea_next.

tools.description: Change title/body/kind/priority/assignee, add or remove tags, and/or append a note. Fenced: requires the claim_token of a live claim held by you. `expected_version` (from sea_get / sea_list row_version) rejects the write with version_conflict if someone changed the ticket since you read it. Notes are the hand-off channel: write what you found and what is left before you release.
